<description>
Add functional coverage for the `gettxspendingprevout` error raised when `mempool_only=false`, no matching spend is in the mempool, and `txospenderindex` is unavailable.

The combined unit and functional coverage report shows this throw in `src/rpc/mempool.cpp` is never reached:
https://github.com/bitcoin/bitcoin/blob/71fa0439278f1d11c9a1aabe67312dcdf1cc8757/src/rpc/mempool.cpp#L1080

The existing test already queries node2 without the index, but `mempool_only` defaults to `true` in that case, so the error is only reachable when `mempool_only=false` is passed explicitly.

The test now checks both sides on node2 with `mempool_only=false`: it  succeeds while the spends are still in the mempool, and raises the error once they are mined.
</description>

<commits>
edf0d13ad5 test: cover gettxspendingprevout error without txospenderindex

When `mempool_only=false` is passed to a node without `txospenderindex`
and the mempool has no spend for a requested outpoint, the RPC throws
"Mempool lacks a relevant spend, and txospenderindex is unavailable."
This path was not covered by any test.

The existing node2 query does not reach it because `mempool_only`
defaults to `true` when the index is unavailable. Pass it explicitly
and check both cases: the call succeeds while the spends are still in
the mempool, and raises the error once they are mined.
</commits>
